name: tripseki
description: Read and edit your Tripseki trip itineraries from ChatGPT: day-by-day plans, bookings, to-dos and change history, through your own account and within your own permissions.

interface.shortDescription: Read and edit your trip plans
interface.longDescription:
Tripseki keeps a trip's flights, stays, restaurants, tickets, trains and to-dos in one day-by-day itinerary that you plan together with your travel companions. Connect your Tripseki account and ChatGPT can work with your trips and start new ones.

What ChatGPT can do:
- Show your trips, a trip's outline, or one day in full: times, flight numbers, terminals, seats, addresses and booking references.
- Start a new trip and fill in its days, if you allow editing for all of your trips.
- Add, change, move and delete itinerary items, and add or tick off to-dos, if you allow editing.
- Tell you what changed in a trip, who changed it, and whether it was done in the app, by an import or by an assistant.
- Restore an item deleted by mistake, within 30 days.

What stays in your control:
- You sign in with your own Tripseki account and choose read-only (the default) or read and edit, for all of your trips or only the ones you pick.
- ChatGPT never has more access than you: in a trip where you are a viewer, it can only read.
- Every change to an item needs that item's latest version, so an edit someone else made in the meantime is never silently overwritten.
- Booking references on items that other members created stay hidden.
- It cannot rename or delete trips, manage members or sharing, record expenses or upload documents.
- You can revoke access at any time in Tripseki under Me > Connected assistants.

Tripseki is available on the web at tripseki.com and as an iOS app.
defaultPrompt: Show my next trip day by day, with flight times and hotel addresses.
Plan a new 5-day trip to Tokyo for me: create the trip, then add a plan for each day.
What changed in my shared trip this week, and who changed it?

positive.description: See which trips the account has and the day-by-day outline of one of them.
positive.prompt: What trips do I have in Tripseki? Give me a day-by-day outline of my Kyoto · Osaka trip (京都 · 大阪).
positive.expected_behavior: Two trips, both with role owner: 京都 · 大阪 (5 days) and 東京 (a finished 4-day trip). A "Nara weekend" trip left by an earlier run of the third case may be listed as well. The outline lists Day 1 to Day 5 with 10 items in time order: Day 1 flight TPE 桃園 → KIX 關西 at 09:20 and Hotel The Celestine 京都祇園; Day 2 伏見稻荷大社 千本鳥居, 菊乃井 本店 and 清水寺; Day 3 京都 → 新大阪 and Cross Hotel 大阪; Day 4 環球影城 and 道頓堀 一蘭; Day 5 flight KIX 關西 → TPE 桃園 at 14:30. The same trips and days appear at tripseki.com.

positive.description: Read one day in full, including flight details and the booking references this account entered itself (not hidden, because the account created these items).
positive.prompt: On day 1 of my Kyoto · Osaka trip, when does my flight leave and land, from which terminals, what is my seat and booking reference, and what are the hotel's address and check-out time?
positive.expected_behavior: EVA Air BR132 departs TPE Terminal 2 at 09:20 and lands at KIX Terminal 1 at 13:00, seat 21A, booking reference DEMO4Q. Hotel The Celestine 京都祇園: check-in 15:00, check-out on Day 3 at 11:00, address 京都市東山区八坂新地 570-113, booking reference CEL20931. This matches the item details at tripseki.com.

positive.description: Plan a new trip from scratch: create the trip, then fill in its days. Needs "Also allow editing trips" and "All trips (including future ones)"; a connection limited to chosen trips cannot create trips.
positive.prompt: Turn 1: "Plan a new two-day trip in Tripseki called "Nara weekend" for next Saturday and Sunday: Todai-ji at 10:00 and Nara Park at 13:00 on the first day, and Kasuga Taisha at 09:30 on the second." Turn 2, after ChatGPT has confirmed the title and the dates: "Yes, go ahead."
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT looks at the existing trips first and confirms the title and dates before it creates anything (the tool description asks it to). After turn 2, tripseki.com (after a page reload) lists a third trip, "Nara weekend", owned by the account and dated next Saturday to Sunday: Day 1 has Todai-ji at 10:00 and Nara Park at 13:00, Day 2 has Kasuga Taisha at 09:30. The new trip is private: it has no share link, and nobody is notified. 京都 · 大阪 and 東京 are unchanged. If an earlier run of this case already left a "Nara weekend" trip, the expected behaviour is different and also correct: ChatGPT points out the existing trip and asks before creating a second one, and nothing is created unless the user confirms. To run the case from scratch, delete the old trip first at tripseki.com (trip menu > "Delete trip").

positive.description: Rearrange an existing item. Every change to an item must carry that item's latest updatedAt (optimistic lock), so the second change has to use the version the first change returned.
positive.prompt: Move Kiyomizu-dera (清水寺) from day 2 to the morning of day 3, 09:00 to 10:30, before the train to Osaka.
positive.expected_behavior: After a page reload at tripseki.com, 清水寺 is no longer on Day 2 and is on Day 3 at 09:00–10:30, before 京都 → 新大阪 at 11:30. The optimistic lock shows in the tool-call details: update_item's expectedUpdatedAt is the updatedAt that move_item returned. If ChatGPT sends the older version from get_day instead, Tripseki refuses that call with item_modified and the current item, writes nothing, and ChatGPT retries with the current version; the end state is the same.

positive.description: Delete an item, then undo the deletion. Deleted items can be restored once within 30 days.
positive.prompt: Turn 1: "Delete the Ichiran dinner (道頓堀 一蘭) on day 4 of my Kyoto · Osaka trip." Turn 2, after ChatGPT asks for confirmation: "Yes, delete that Ichiran dinner." Turn 3, after the deletion succeeds: "That was a mistake, please restore it."
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT should confirm before deleting (the tool description asks it to). Before confirmation, the item is unchanged. After turn 2 succeeds, 道頓堀 一蘭 is gone from Day 4 at tripseki.com (after a page reload) and ChatGPT says it can be restored within 30 days. After turn 3 it is back on Day 4 at 19:30, as a new item with a new id. Asking to restore the same deletion again returns that same item instead of a duplicate.

negative.description:
The user asks to delete a whole trip.
Why the plugin should not act: No tool deletes or renames a trip; only the trip owner can delete a trip, in the Tripseki app. Deleting every item one by one would not delete the trip and would destroy its content.
Expected result: ChatGPT replies, without needing a Tripseki tool, that trips cannot be deleted through Tripseki, and points to "Delete trip" in the Tripseki app. Even if it looks the trip up first, it never calls delete_item on the trip's items as a workaround; the 東京 trip and its 4 items are unchanged.
negative.prompt: Delete my 東京 trip from Tripseki.

negative.description:
The user asks to record and split an expense.
Why the plugin should not act: Expenses are recorded in the Tripseki app ("Add expense"). The tools can read the expense linked to an item but cannot create or change expenses, and writing the amount into an itinerary item would not make a real, splittable expense.
Expected result: ChatGPT replies, without needing a Tripseki tool, that it cannot record expenses in Tripseki, and suggests "Add expense" in the app. No expense is created, and no itinerary item is added unless the user then explicitly asks for one.
negative.prompt: Log a ¥1,200 taxi on day 1 of my Kyoto · Osaka trip as an expense and split it between us.

negative.description:
A nearby but out-of-scope request: search, booking and payment.
Why the plugin should not act: Tripseki is a trip planner, not a booking or payment service. None of its tools search fares, book or pay, and the request does not need the user's Tripseki data.
Expected result: Tripseki is not called. ChatGPT answers without it (for example, general advice on comparing fares) and makes clear it cannot book or pay through Tripseki; it may offer to add the flight to the itinerary after the user has booked it elsewhere.
negative.prompt: Find the cheapest flight from Taipei to Osaka next month, book it and pay with my card.

review.commerce_description: Tripseki does not sell travel products, make bookings or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release of the Tripseki plugin. Connect your Tripseki account to see your trips, days and items and what changed in them, and, if you allow editing, start new trips, add, change, move, delete and restore itinerary items and add or tick off to-dos. Access is read-only by default, never exceeds your own role in each trip, and deleted items can be restored for 30 days.

zh-TW.subtitle: 查看與編輯你的旅程規劃
zh-TW.description:
Tripseki 旅跡把一趟旅行的航班、住宿、餐廳、票券、交通與待辦，依天排成一份行程，和同行的人一起規劃。連結你的 Tripseki 帳號後，ChatGPT 就能直接處理你的旅程，也能建立新的旅程。

ChatGPT 可以：
- 列出你的旅程、整趟旅程的大綱，或某一天的完整內容：時間、航班號碼、航廈、座位、地址與訂位代號。
- 建立新的旅程並排好每一天（你允許編輯、範圍是全部旅程時）。
- 新增、修改、移動、刪除行程項目，新增或勾選待辦（你允許編輯時）。
- 告訴你旅程裡改了什麼、誰改的，以及是在 App 裡、匯入，還是由助理改的。
- 還原誤刪的項目（30 天內）。

由你掌控：
- 用你自己的 Tripseki 帳號登入，選擇只讀（預設）或可編輯，以及全部旅程或只限你挑的旅程。
- ChatGPT 的權限永遠不超過你本人：你是檢視者的旅程，它只能讀。
- 每次修改項目都要帶該項目的最新版本，別人剛改過的內容不會被默默蓋掉。
- 其他成員建立的項目，訂位代號會遮蔽。
- 不能改名或刪除旅程，不能管理成員或分享，不能記帳，也不能上傳文件。
- 隨時可以在 Tripseki 的「我」→「已連結的助理」撤銷。

Tripseki 有網頁版（tripseki.com）與 iOS App。
